findings.finding: A rise from a more negative 10Y-2Y spread was called widening, potentially confusing inversion depth with algebraic spread change.
findings.fix: Changed widened to increased; retained -32 bps, +11 bps and correctly identified inverted bull steepening.

findings.finding: Chinese US-tracking ETF demand was repeated without its direct citation in that paragraph.
findings.fix: Attached own-date n0167 to the repeated ETF-demand statement. No aggregate capital-flow inference was introduced.

findings.finding: An unanchored prospective stock-split aside could imply a company event unsupported by the cited ASML headline.
findings.fix: Replaced only that sentence with a conditional shipment-to-earnings test supported by the existing equipment thesis.

claim_checks.result: Matched Treasury 2Y 4.60%, 10Y 4.28%, -32 bps, 20-observation -12/-1/+11 bps and curve label to Treasury fields. Matched every quoted equity/ETF/index/commodity close and return to the named own-card instrument, completed 2024-07-05 session and stated horizon. BTC/ETH use the completed 2024-07-07 daily close, not equity Friday. Checked local Samsung KRW, Toyota JPY, BHP AUD, BMW EUR and Polish PLN against local lines; ASML explicitly US USD line. DXY is an index, no numeric spot FX.

All 108 cited complete titles read and matched to actual propositions. Older FedEx/Micron/Nike material is released earnings/guidance inside 14 days; June macro/PMI/housing/RBA/BOJ material is baseline evidence inside 35 days. July corporate/political/trade headlines are inside seven days. Samsung preliminary profit indication remains preliminary; earnings season remains pending; Three Mile Island talks remain reported potential, not approval or contract.

Constellation Brands beer/EPS is separated from Constellation Energy nuclear talks. JPMorgan fees remain proposed customer adjustment; Netflix Canadian-tax appeal remains pending. Chinese ETF demand, Calastone fund-channel flow reporting and Emcure IPO bids are not generalized into national capital flows. HYG/LQD and market price changes are expressly not measured spread, subscriptions or ownership.

Selective US/technology/semiconductor bullish stances remain contingent on cash conversion; mixed China/Europe/Poland and defensive duration calls carry explicit reversal tests. Bearish European autos is consistent with tariff/retaliation risk and has a cover condition. Themes describe attention gaps without invented ownership statistics.

style_depth.assessment: Substantive date-specific causal comparisons and falsifiable actions throughout all 36 blocks. CN connects resale turnover, developer cash, collateral, land revenue, demographics and export barriers; PL separates consumption/wages from rate, fiscal, governance and defense channels. Both end with genuine divergence analysis. Sector and catalyst text distinguishes agreement/guidance/approval from delivered earnings; no filler addition made during review.
style_depth.limits: Headline-only evidence supports the stated headline facts and conditional mechanisms, not article-body details or realized future outcomes.
